actions.warn: A warning. Nothing was taken down.
actions.hide: Hidden from buyers while it is reviewed.
actions.remove: Taken down after it was live.
actions.suspend: Paused until the issue is resolved.

severities.low: Usually fixed by editing. Repeats are noted but rarely lead to more.
severities.medium: Content comes down. Repeats can lead to a shop or account suspension (Terms 7.3).
severities.high: Content comes down and the shop or account may be suspended on a first offense.
severities.critical: The account is closed. Barta may skip every warning step (Terms 7.3).

rules.title: Weapons and ammunition
rules.explanation: Firearms, ammunition, explosives and working weapons of any kind can't be sold on Barta. Costume and prop weapons are fine when they are made of foam, resin or another non-functional material and the listing says so clearly.
rules.fix_guidance: If this is a prop or costume piece, say in the title and description what it is made of and that it does not work as a weapon, then request a review. Real weapons, parts and ammunition can't be relisted.

rules.title: Illegal drugs and paraphernalia
rules.explanation: Controlled substances, equipment for making drugs, and drug paraphernalia can't be listed or promoted on Barta.

rules.title: Counterfeit goods
rules.explanation: Items made to imitate a branded product and pass as the real thing aren't allowed. Authentic branded items, handmade pieces inspired by a franchise, and customized products are welcome as long as they are honestly described.
rules.fix_guidance: If you made this piece yourself, describe it as handmade or fan-made, and take out brand logos, tags or packaging that make it look like the original. If it is authentic, request a review and tell us how you can show that.

rules.title: Fan-made items shown as official
rules.explanation: Fan-made and inspired items are allowed, but they can't be called official, licensed or authorized merchandise unless they are.
rules.fix_guidance: Remove words like "official", "licensed" or "authentic" and any studio or brand logos from the title, photos and description. Saying an item is inspired by a character is fine.

rules.title: Stolen property
rules.explanation: Items obtained through theft, fraud or other illegal means can't be sold on Barta.

rules.title: Hazardous materials
rules.explanation: Toxic chemicals, radioactive materials and anything that is a health or safety risk when shipped can't be listed.

rules.title: Recalled products
rules.explanation: Products under a government or manufacturer recall can't be sold.

rules.title: Tobacco and vaping products
rules.explanation: Cigarettes, e-cigarettes and vaping products can't be sold on Barta.

rules.title: Alcoholic beverages
rules.explanation: Alcoholic drinks can't be sold on Barta.

rules.title: Human remains and body parts
rules.explanation: Human remains, tissue, organs and bodily fluids can't be listed.

rules.title: Live animals
rules.explanation: Live animals can't be sold on Barta.

rules.title: Items that promote hatred or violence
rules.explanation: Items that promote, glorify or incite violence, terrorism, or hatred against people based on race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability or national origin can't be sold.

rules.title: Items containing personal information
rules.explanation: Items that contain other people's personal, financial or confidential information, such as data lists or documents, can't be sold.

rules.title: Items that need a special license
rules.explanation: Items that need a government license to sell, such as medical devices or prescription items, can only be sold by sellers who hold that license.
rules.fix_guidance: If you hold the license, request a review and tell us the license type and number. If you don't, the item can't be listed.

rules.title: Misleading description
rules.explanation: A listing's title and description have to be accurate and match the item a buyer will receive.
rules.fix_guidance: Edit the title and description so they describe exactly what you are selling, including size, materials and anything that is not included, then request a review.

rules.title: Photos don't show the actual item
rules.explanation: Listing photos have to show the item being sold. Stock images, mockups or photos of a different item can mislead buyers.
rules.fix_guidance: Replace the photos with your own pictures of the item you will ship. For made-to-order work, show a finished example and say in the description that it is an example.

rules.title: Price doesn't match the item
rules.explanation: The listed price has to be the real price for the item shown. Placeholder prices, or a price that only covers part of what the photos and title suggest, mislead buyers.
rules.fix_guidance: Set the price to what a buyer actually pays for the item shown, or split the listing into separate items or variants with their own prices.

rules.title: Condition isn't accurate
rules.explanation: The condition you choose has to match the item. Wear, damage or missing parts must be shown or described.
rules.fix_guidance: Update the condition and describe any wear, flaws or missing pieces. Add a photo of anything a buyer would want to see before buying.

rules.title: Listed in the wrong category
rules.explanation: Listings have to be accurate, and that includes where they are filed. An item in the wrong category is hard to find and shows up for buyers looking for something else.
rules.fix_guidance: Edit the listing and pick the category that best matches the item, then request a review.

rules.title: Search manipulation
rules.explanation: Stuffing titles or tags with unrelated keywords, brand names or other shops' names to show up in more searches is not allowed.
rules.fix_guidance: Keep the title and tags to words that describe the item itself. Remove unrelated terms, brand names you aren't selling, and repeated keywords.

rules.title: Price manipulation
rules.explanation: Fake discounts, inflated "was" prices, and coordinated pricing meant to mislead buyers are not allowed.
rules.fix_guidance: Show only real prices and real sale prices. Remove any reference price you never charged.

rules.title: Orders not fulfilled as described
rules.explanation: Sellers have to ship or hand off orders promptly and the way the listing describes. Repeated late, missing or incomplete orders put buyers at risk.
rules.fix_guidance: Ship or refund every open order, add tracking where you can, and set handling times you can keep. Then request a review and tell us what changed.

rules.title: Return policy missing or unlawful
rules.explanation: Each shop has to state its return and refund policy clearly, and the policy has to follow consumer protection law where you and your buyers are.
rules.fix_guidance: Add a clear return and refund policy to your shop settings or listing description, then request a review.

rules.title: Selling against product safety or export law
rules.explanation: Sellers have to follow the laws that apply to what they sell, including product safety, labeling and export rules.
rules.fix_guidance: Add any required safety warnings or labels, stop shipping to places the item can't legally go, then request a review.

rules.title: Organizer terms that fine vendors
rules.explanation: Organizer terms can set refund windows and rules, but they can't charge vendors fines, penalties or late fees.
rules.fix_guidance: Edit your event terms to remove any fines, penalties or late fees, then request a review.

rules.title: Event not run as described
rules.explanation: Organizers are responsible for running the event the way the listing describes it, including the date, place and what tickets and booths include.
rules.fix_guidance: Update the event page so it matches what is happening, tell ticket holders and vendors what changed, and offer refunds where the change affects them.

rules.title: Membership benefits not delivered
rules.explanation: A creator who offers a membership has to deliver what the offer describes, and keep member content available through the period members already paid for.
rules.fix_guidance: Restore the member content or benefits, or update the offer so it matches what you deliver and refund members who paid for something they did not get.

rules.title: Nudity
rules.explanation: Nudity isn't allowed anywhere on Barta, including listings, creator pages, Backstage and member-only posts. Costume, cosplay, body paint and prop photography is welcome when no nudity is shown.
rules.fix_guidance: Replace the photo or post with one that shows no nudity, then request a review if you think the call was wrong.

rules.title: Sexually explicit content
rules.explanation: Sexually explicit images, video and writing aren't allowed anywhere on Barta, public or member-only.
rules.fix_guidance: Take down the explicit content and replace it with something that follows the content rules, then request a review.

rules.title: Offering sexual services
rules.explanation: Listings, posts or messages that offer sexual services aren't allowed.

rules.title: Paid "lewd" or "spicy" sets
rules.explanation: Memberships and tips can't be used to sell sexually suggestive content, including so-called "lewd" or "spicy" photo sets, even when the photos show no nudity.
rules.fix_guidance: Remove the suggestive posts and any offer or tier that promises them, and make sure your membership describes the creative work members get. Then request a review.

rules.title: Child sexual abuse material
rules.explanation: Barta has zero tolerance for child sexual abuse material. It is removed, the account is closed, and it is reported to the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children as the law requires.

rules.title: Violent extremism
rules.explanation: Content that promotes, glorifies or incites violence or terrorism isn't allowed.

rules.title: Hate
rules.explanation: Content or messages that promote hatred against people based on race, ethnicity, religion, disability, gender, sexual orientation, national origin or any other protected characteristic aren't allowed.

rules.title: Sharing someone's private information
rules.explanation: Posting another person's personal, financial or confidential information, such as their home address, phone number or documents, isn't allowed.
rules.fix_guidance: Remove the other person's information. If it was shared by mistake, request a review and tell us.

rules.title: Promoting prohibited items
rules.explanation: Posts, comments and messages can't promote or offer items that can't be sold on Barta, even if the sale would happen somewhere else.
rules.fix_guidance: Remove the post or the part of it that promotes the item, then request a review.

rules.title: Defamatory content
rules.explanation: Content that makes false statements damaging to another person's or business's reputation isn't allowed.
rules.fix_guidance: Remove the statements about the other person or business. Honest reviews of your own experience are fine.

rules.title: Graphic or harmful content
rules.explanation: Content that is obscene, abusive, graphic or otherwise harmful can be removed, even if it isn't covered by a more specific rule.
rules.fix_guidance: Replace the content with something less graphic, then request a review if you think the call was wrong.

rules.title: Charging for prohibited content
rules.explanation: You can't charge for, or accept tips or membership payments for, content that breaks the content rules.
rules.fix_guidance: Remove the content and any offer, tier or tip request tied to it, then request a review.

rules.title: Content you don't have the rights to
rules.explanation: You can only post and sell content you own or have permission to use. Fan-made work you created is fine. Copying someone else's designs, illustrations, writing or patterns isn't.
rules.fix_guidance: Replace the copied material with your own work, or get permission from the rights holder. If you already have permission, request a review and say so.

rules.title: Pirated or leaked work
rules.explanation: Pirated, leaked or copied files, patterns, courses and other digital goods can't be shared or sold.

rules.title: Photos taken from someone else
rules.explanation: Listing and shop photos have to be yours or used with permission. Photos copied from another seller, shop or website aren't allowed.
rules.fix_guidance: Replace the photos with pictures you took yourself, then request a review.

rules.title: Removed after a copyright notice
rules.explanation: A rights holder sent Barta a copyright (DMCA) notice about this content, and we removed it as the law requires.
rules.fix_guidance: If you believe it was removed by mistake, you can send a counter-notification to legal@barta.shop with the information the DMCA requires. You can also request a review here and we will tell you what to include.

rules.title: Repeated intellectual property violations
rules.explanation: Accounts that repeatedly infringe other people's intellectual property are closed.

rules.title: Harassment
rules.explanation: Harassing, abusing or bullying other people in messages, comments, reviews or posts isn't allowed.

rules.title: Threats and intimidation
rules.explanation: Threatening or intimidating anyone on Barta, or anywhere about a Barta transaction, isn't allowed.

rules.title: Impersonation or false identity
rules.explanation: You can't pretend to be another person, creator, shop or business, or set up an account under a false identity.
rules.fix_guidance: If this is a mix-up, for example a shop name that is too close to another, change the name and photos and request a review. We may ask you to confirm who you are.

rules.title: Spam and unsolicited advertising
rules.explanation: Messages are for real questions and conversations about listings, shops and orders. Bulk messages, unsolicited ads and repeated promotion aren't allowed.

rules.title: Phishing
rules.explanation: Messages or links that try to collect someone's password, payment details or personal information aren't allowed.

rules.title: Scams and fraud
rules.explanation: Deceiving buyers, sellers or Barta to take money or goods, such as selling items you don't have or fake payment requests, isn't allowed.

rules.title: Chargeback without trying to resolve it
rules.explanation: Buyers agree to try to resolve an order problem with the seller, and through Barta if needed, before filing a chargeback with their bank.

rules.title: Taking payment off Barta
rules.explanation: Steering buyers to pay you outside Barta, such as through a payment app, bank transfer or another site, for something they found here isn't allowed. It also removes the buyer's protection.
rules.fix_guidance: Remove payment handles, outside links and requests to pay elsewhere from your listings, shop and messages, and take orders through Barta checkout.

rules.title: Sharing contact details to go around Barta
rules.explanation: Sharing phone numbers, outside email addresses or social handles so a sale can happen outside Barta isn't allowed.
rules.fix_guidance: Remove the contact details and keep the conversation and the sale on Barta.

rules.title: Getting around Barta fees
rules.explanation: Setting up listings or orders to avoid fees, such as moving the price into shipping or marking online sales as in-person, isn't allowed.
rules.fix_guidance: Put the full item price in the price field and record each sale the way it happened.

rules.title: Money laundering and financial crime
rules.explanation: Using Barta to move money for laundering, terrorist financing or other financial crimes is prohibited, and we may hold payouts while we investigate.

rules.title: Fake or manipulated reviews
rules.explanation: Reviews have to come from real buyers. Writing your own reviews, trading reviews, paying for them, or pressuring buyers to change them isn't allowed.

rules.title: Bots and scraping
rules.explanation: Using bots, scrapers or other automated tools to access or collect data from Barta needs our written consent.
rules.fix_guidance: Stop the automated access. If you need data or an integration, contact support@barta.shop.

rules.title: Unauthorized access
rules.explanation: Trying to get into other people's accounts or Barta's systems isn't allowed.

rules.title: Malware and malicious files
rules.explanation: Uploading or sending viruses, malware or other malicious code isn't allowed.

rules.title: Disrupting the service
rules.explanation: Interfering with how Barta works, or with other people's use of it, isn't allowed.

rules.title: Illegal activity
rules.explanation: Barta can't be used for anything that breaks the law.

rules.title: Under the minimum age
rules.explanation: You have to be at least 16 to use Barta, and anyone under 18 needs a parent or guardian's consent.
rules.fix_guidance: If you meet the age requirement, request a review. We may ask you to confirm your age or your guardian's consent.

rules.title: Inaccurate account details
rules.explanation: Your account and shop details have to be accurate and up to date.
rules.fix_guidance: Update your name, contact and shop details in settings, then request a review.

rules.title: Locked to protect the account
rules.explanation: We saw activity that suggests someone else may have access to this account, so we paused it to protect you and the people you trade with.
rules.fix_guidance: Reset your password, check your email account is secure, then request a review so we can turn things back on.

rules.title: Multiple accounts used to deceive
rules.explanation: Each person may have one personal account. Extra accounts used to manipulate the marketplace or deceive other people are closed, along with the accounts linked to them.

rules.title: Getting around an enforcement action
rules.explanation: Creating a new account or shop to get around a suspension or ban isn't allowed, and every account involved is closed.

rules.title: Repeated violations
rules.explanation: We keep records of enforcement. After repeated violations of the Terms, a shop or account can be suspended, including its creator memberships, and continued violations lead to permanent closure.

rules.title: Risk of harm to others
rules.explanation: We may pause or close an account whose activity puts other people, Barta or third parties at risk, including while we investigate possible fraud. Held payouts may be delayed during the review.

rules.title: Inactive account
rules.explanation: Accounts that haven't been used for 12 months or more may be closed.
rules.fix_guidance: Sign in and request a review if you want to keep the account.

rules.title: Waiting for a person to review it
rules.explanation: Some uploads and posts, including files on member-only posts, are checked by a person before buyers can see them. Nothing is wrong yet. We hide it only until the review is done.
